methodology: First-pass thematic assessment of 13:21–25, following 13:16–20 checkpoint on PR #445. PR title search for 13:21–25 found no match; complete main/open-PR/Supabase reconciliation remains unavailable. Earlier primary-text critical passages were not independently checked; no external association is verified or public.

assessments.subject: Maintaining bonds commanded by God, reverence and fear of bad reckoning
assessments.evidence: The nature of the commanded bonds is not specified in this verse; avoid equating it automatically with a single biblical kinship law.

assessments.subject: Patience for God's favor, prayer, charitable spending, repelling evil with good
assessments.evidence: Ethical parallels may exist in earlier wisdom and Christian traditions, but source-specific wording and chronological transmission remain unchecked.

assessments.subject: Gardens of Eden, righteous relatives, angels entering through gates
assessments.evidence: Eden and angelic imagery are broad ancient motifs; the precise combination and differences require primary-text comparison.

assessments.subject: Angelic greeting of peace for patience and the excellent final dwelling
assessments.evidence: Peace greetings and eschatological reward should not be conflated with specific antecedent narratives without textual verification.

assessments.subject: Breaking God's covenant, severing commanded bonds, corruption on earth, curse
assessments.evidence: Contrast with 13:20–21 is intratextual; earlier covenant sanctions remain a research lead, not an established textual source.

historical_dossier.topic: Covenant fidelity, ethical response and eschatological gardens in 13:21–25
historical_dossier.comparative_observation: Analyze covenant obligations and their violation (21,25), patient ethics (22), Eden and family reunion (23), and angelic greeting (24) as distinct but connected Qur'anic units. Do not claim historical borrowing from general motifs.
